Matt Day / Bloomberg :

 Amazon spent $77B+ on property and equipment in Q3, leading to a free cash outflow of $42.4B; Amazon said in July that it would likely spend $220B in 2026 capex   —  Amazon.com Inc. spent more than $77 billion on property and equipment in the third quarter, far more than analysts' estimates …
